Base Metals Dashboard基本金属宏观仪表盘

Copper, aluminium, zinc, nickel, lead, tin, iron ore and battery metals as markets: LME and Chinese exchange prices, the SHFE import window and the COMEX–LME copper spread, visible stocks, Chinese demand and positioning. Cross-Market Arbitrage跨市场套利

The SHFE import window (Shanghai price minus LME converted at the central parity with 13% VAT) and the tariff-driven COMEX–LME copper spread.上期所进口窗口（沪价减按中间价换算并含13%增值税的伦铜价）与关税驱动的COMEX–LME铜价差。
